name: Orchel
personality: Pure and compassionate to the point of airheadedness, she cannot ignore anyone in distress and never removes her gold cat-faced mask in public.
story: A priest of Credna Temple in Dagsion who hides her face behind a gold cat mask. She joins the army in Part III on every route.

personalSkill.name: Solid and Sturdy
personalSkill.effect: Def+5; unit is armored and cannot change to cavalry or flying classes.

joins: Automatically in Part III: Salvation, First Section, on all routes. Guides advise completing her Part I paralogue to be safe.

build.role: Armored battle healer and cursed-gear sink (Automaton)
build.notes: Curse never moves her gauge: Velheit, Gundogya, Anguishing Shield, Aaron's Rod and Poisonbone Chain are hers. Join class ?.

guide.role: Armored battle healer and the cursed-gear sink (Automaton)
guide.summary: Curse never moves her gauge, so she wears the cursed pieces the army collected with no Burst risk. Stand her on the front line beside Eshmel: doubled White Magic heals on player phase, Velheit counters on enemy phase, and Strahl and Lanze answer shields and undead.
guide.playstyle: Player phase: heal first (Harmonic Soul heals her too), then Seraphim or an axe hit. Enemy phase: Def and Res growth 60 each and the Anguishing Shield take the hits. Elizabeth once per map puts her in Overblaze for the boss turn.
keys: Fire Strahl on Dagda's shield in Sec 1, with Cai's Blackfire.
Take Aaron's Rod from Talimun in Sec 2 Free Time: Mag/Dex +4 at no gauge cost.
Arena Heavy weeks from Sec 2: Axe B and Heavy C (Armored Combat, Dex +5).
Push Axe A by Sec 4 for Velheit (Hit 95, Wt 5); Gundogya on mage maps.
Undead maps: every cursed piece off (Offset Curse); Iron Axe +4, Hexlock, Healing Staff.
watch: Undead: any cursed piece, shield and Rod included, can zero her hit (Offset Curse). The forecast won't show it.
Weight: Velheit 5 + Anguishing Shield 8 + Aaron's Rod 8 = 21 (Gundogya 12 on mage maps: 28). Spd 10 growth: doubled anyway; Def/Res carry her. The Rod comes off first.
Axe A: join rank ?; Arena seats bench first. Without A she keeps the Hammer and magic.
Armored: Solid and Sturdy makes her armored in every class (?): (Infantry) abilities do nothing.
Self-Repair: level ?. Equip it the day it shows: Elizabeth's Overblaze then heals her every phase.

decisions.pick: Bishop on join, Wiseman at Lv 45 (White A)
decisions.why: Both classes carry Axe and White Magic, so Velheit and the heals sit on one unit. Castle Knight (Axe A, Spear A) is the armored axe line, but it drops her magic, Predictive Sense and Harmonic Soul.
decisions.else: Castle Knight if Axe A lands and White A stalls

decisions.topic: Hold the cursed gear on her
decisions.pick: Velheit, Gundogya, Anguishing Shield, Aaron's Rod, Poisonbone Chain
decisions.why: Automaton: Curse never moves her gauge, so she keeps the stats and her Diadem of Duality procs (Atk +3, 25%) with no Burst. On an Underworld unit the same kit adds 3 per combat.
The Avatar (White S, Black S) fits her spell lists, but Sirocco holds it and each Divine class has one holder.
